goal: Restore the existing Issue #66 claimed lifecycle projection to the established I06+ Knowledge Delta gate contract before beginning semantic-batch implementation.

verified_facts.statement: Issue #66 is open and claimed on ownership branch agent/infra-0066-semantic-batch-contracts; claim bookkeeping commit fcfb84e9cee8a9cec21adc6581d384c6fac84653 is exactly one commit ahead of protected main 7347f25fe67de186c85c5a1ec0459c6ccffcc3b8 and changes only BUILD_STATUS.json by adding I09-0066 to active_task_ids.

Infrastructure CI run 32011636848 on exact claim head fcfb84e9cee8a9cec21adc6581d384c6fac84653 failed exactly one of 387 discovered tests: test_knowledge_delta_gate.KnowledgeDeltaGateTests.test_actual_repository_gate_is_part_of_full_unittest_discovery, because knowledge-deltas/I09-0066.json was missing.

Protected main at 7347f25fe67de186c85c5a1ec0459c6ccffcc3b8 has successful Infrastructure CI run 31976745367, so the failed claim-state test is caused by incomplete Issue #66 claim bookkeeping rather than a pre-existing protected-main defect.

decisions.decision: Preserve the established Knowledge Delta gate semantics and correct the incomplete claim bookkeeping by adding the canonical knowledge-deltas/I09-0066.json on the existing ownership branch through the controlled publisher with exact-head CAS.
decisions.rationale: The merged gate explicitly requires a canonical Knowledge Delta for every I06+ active or completed task; changing validator, reducer, workflow, or publisher semantics would be unnecessary scope expansion.

decisions.decision: Treat state/current.json as stale historical materialization and do not edit or use it as current lifecycle or DAG truth.
decisions.rationale: Issue #66 lifecycle is established from live GitHub evidence and BUILD_STATUS; changing the stale materialization would mask neither the exact gate failure nor its root cause.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Relax the Knowledge Delta gate so active tasks do not require a delta.
rejected_alternatives.reason: That would change shared validator semantics outside Issue #66 and is unnecessary because the existing lifecycle contract can be satisfied directly.
The failure is deterministic and tied to a missing required repository artifact, so a rerun without state correction would not establish a transient failure.

tests.name: Initial Issue #66 claim-state Infrastructure CI
tests.reference: run 32011636848; exact head fcfb84e9cee8a9cec21adc6581d384c6fac84653; missing knowledge-deltas/I09-0066.json

followups: Require exact-head green Infrastructure CI for this repaired claim state before publishing any Issue #66 implementation source.
After claim-state CI is green, implement only the complete numbered scope and Done conditions of Issue #66; do not run the first semantic batch or start Issue #67.
